question: A family consists of 6 members P, Q, R, S, T, U. Q is the son of R, but R is not the mother of Q. P and R are a married couple. T is the brother of R. S is the daughter of P. U is the brother of P. How many male members are there in the family?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given:

Q is the son of R.

R is not the mother of Q.

P and R are a married couple.

T is the brother of R.

S is the daughter of P.

U is the brother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/410f18397e80dbd35624a0df13a7a7c7abc004514befc1085470951239edbdb2.png] 

Therefore, male members are: R, Q, T, U → Total = 4

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
